OUR 5-YEAR WARRANTY
Standing behind our craftsmanship long after the project ends.

While the industry standard is often one year, at Stebnitz Builders we stand apart by offering a comprehensive 5-year Warranty on our workmanship. We believe true peace of mind shouldn’t expire when the trucks drive away. It’s our promise that your remodel is built to last, and if something isn’t right, we will be there to fix it.

Start Your Project with Confidence
A Relationship Built on Trust
WE ARE HERE, READY TO LISTEN—EVEN YEARS LATER.

Remodeling is a significant investment in both your home and your future. You deserve to know that the team you hired has your back. Our 5-Year Warranty is a testament to the confidence we have in our process, our trade partners, and our skilled carpenters. We don’t just build projects; we build relationships. If an issue arises with our installation or craftsmanship within five years of completion, simply call us. We will assess the situation and make it right, ensuring your home continues to perform as beautifully as the day we finished.

WHAT IS COVERED?
Commitment to Our Craft

Our warranty specifically covers defects in workmanship and installation provided by Stebnitz Builders and our subcontractors.

Carpentry & Installation: Issues arising from the installation of cabinets, trim, windows, doors, and framing.

Mechanical Systems: Workmanship related to plumbing, electrical, and HVAC updates performed under our contract.

Exterior Finishes: Installation defects in siding, roofing, and flashing that could lead to leaks or failure.

Structural Integrity: Any issues related to the structural modifications or additions we constructed.

Note: Manufacturer warranties on specific products (appliances, shingles, etc.) are separate and will be passed directly to you.

Contact our team today to discuss your goals and start the path toward a beautifully reimagined home. We’re here to listen to your ideas and help you discover the full potential of your space.

50 YEARS OF SERVICE
Building Trust Since 1972

For over half a century, Stebnitz Builders has served Walworth County as trusted stewards of our community. From our humble beginnings in general carpentry to becoming the area’s premier design-build remodeling firm, our legacy is built on listening to our neighbors. Today, we remain dedicated to transforming homes, building futures, and setting the standard for craftsmanship, transparency, and the client experience.

THE STEBNITZ LEGACY
Three Generations of Excellence

Founded in 1972 by Stan Stebnitz, our company began with a focus on general carpentry and small additions. By 1986, Stan’s sons—Dave, Gary, and Dan—had purchased the business, expanding our service offerings and solidifying our reputation for quality. In 2008, the tradition of family ownership continued when Dave’s son, Chris Stebnitz, became the third-generation owner. Today, operating from our headquarters in Elkhorn, WI, we combine old-school craftsmanship with 21st-century technology. While we utilize modern tools like 3D design and virtual walkthroughs to enhance your experience, our core principles remain unchanged: always do what’s right, serve others as you expect to be served, and never walk away from a project.

Our Journey

OUR COMMITMENT TO CRAFTSMANSHIP
A legacy built on trust and skill.

For half a century, we have honed our craft, evolved with the industry, and remained steadfast in our core values.

Generations of Leadership: Founded by Chris’ grandfather, expanded by his father and uncles, and now led by Chris Stebnitz, our family’s dedication to quality spans decades.

Community Focused: From sponsoring local events to supporting non-profits, we believe in giving back to the people and organizations in our community who have supported us.

Award-Winning Service: Recognized locally and nationally for customer satisfaction and design excellence, including multiple GuildQuality Service Excellence Awards.

Investing in People: Our team is our greatest asset. We prioritize training, safety, and career development to ensure the highest level of expertise on every job site.

Gary Stebnitz
OWNER 1986 - 2006
So many great memories, Gary. Thanks for all you’ve done to support the growth of the company early on and setting the table for us to build a team to carry that forward for many years.
Chris Stebnitz
PRESIDENT OF STEBNITZ BUILDERS
Fifty years and thousands of clients later, we remain committed to Perfecting the Art of Listening while creating beautiful living spaces and memorable remodeling experiences for homeowners across Walworth County. Keep an eye out for upcoming messages from friends that are celebrating with us!
Victoria Downing
PRESIDENT OF REMODELERS ADVANTAGE
Victoria Downing, President of Remodelers Advantage Inc, offers her unique perspective of what it means for Stebnitz Builders to celebrate 50 years. Stebnitz Builders has been a member of RA since 1995, learning from other successful remodeling business owners across the country. RA facilitates “Roundtables,” a world-class peer advisory program that brings together smart, motivated, remodeling professionals, to help one another grow. Stebnitz Builders is a founding member of the Mentor 2 Roundtable, consisting primarily of companies who had shown mastery of their business and an interest in higher-level understanding.
Dennis Carnes
CFO OF KEEFE REAL ESTATE
Our friends say the nicest things … Dennis Carnes, CFO with Keefe & Associates, took a minute to congratulate us on our 50th Anniversary and reflected back on the many ways Stebnitz Builders has had an impact on the community.
Larry and Cathy Bray
CLIENT SINCE 2014
Larry and Cathy Bray took a minute to send their congratulations to us for 50 years and to reflect on the great experience they had remodeling their kitchen. Thanks for the kind words, guys. We love working with family, too!
Jason Tadlock
ELKHORN AREA SCHOOL DISTRICT ADMINISTRATOR
While we enjoyed being their contractor of choice for the last 10 years or so, we’ve also had the pleasure of working alongside the Elkhorn Area School District as a volunteer for all kinds of educational and sporting events. The memories we’ve made with teachers and students during that time, will last forever. Thanks for the kind words, Jason!
Kent Gebauer
HOME LUMBER
Kent Gebauer has been our right-hand man when it comes to building products. Ensuring our clients have all the information on options available, providing us all the necessary information for proper installation, and directing all the right products to the right jobsite, every day, Kent has been there. Thanks for all you do to make our clients, our teams, and our projects successful, Kent!
Barney Brugger
REMODELING CONSULTANT 2013-2022
We had a wonderful time working alongside a true professional like Barney. For 10 years (2013-2022), Barney reshaped the role of Remodeling Consultant by combining his deep technical expertise with a sharp focus on client relationships, creating amazing spaces and exceptional experiences for so many clients. We appreciate the kind words and for all you’ve done to create raving fans of Stebnitz Builders.
Michael and Donna Capposerre
CLIENTS SINCE 2018
Mike and Donna Capposerre have been clients of Stebnitz Builders for several years. We’ve completed numerous projects for them and enjoyed working with them both, every time. Mike has quite the personality. His laugh is infectious! Listen for it the next time you’re at the Walgreens in Elkhorn. Chances are pretty good you’ll hear it. Thanks for the kind words!! We look forward to the next project!
Luke and Becki Kuchenberg
CLIENTS SINCE 2020
Becki and Luke Kuchenberg, with FORM Wealth Management, sent us this wonderful message, describing what it was like working with Stebnitz Builders to design and build their new kitchen and living space. They also provide a great perspective on what it means to partner with a company celebrating their 50th year in business. Thank you, Becki and Luke, for your kind words! We are lucky to have so many amazing clients, like yourself, we get to work with!
Dave Stebnitz
SON, FATHER, AND GRANDFATHER SERVING STEBNITZ BUILDERS
Dave Stebnitz reflects on his time with his brothers, Dan and Gary, purchasing their father’s company and building it in to a resource serving so many more homeowners around Walworth County for twenty years. Thanks for the insight and for the kind words, Dad!
Dan Stebnitz
ESTIMATOR AND OWNER 1986-2008
Great memories, Dan! Thanks for sharing and thanks for being there, every step of the way, as this company has grown – 50 years in the making.
Paul Winans
PEER MENTOR, REMODELERS ADVANTAGE
I couldn’t think of a better person to lend perspective on what this celebration means. As a successful remodeler and an even more successful mentor with Remodelers Advantage, Paul has been an integral part in my growth and the growth of the company. Thank you for all you’ve done along our journey, Sensei.
Tim Faller
SENIOR CONSULTANT AND "MASTER OF PRODUCTION" - REMODELER'S ADVANTAGE
Tim Faller, Senior Consultant and “Master of Production” with Remodelers Advantage Inc, offers his unique perspective of what it means for Stebnitz Builders to celebrate 50 years. Stebnitz Builders has been a member of RA since 1995, learning from other successful remodeling business owners across the country. RA facilitates “Roundtables,” a world-class peer advisory program that brings together smart, motivated, remodeling professionals, to help one another grow.
Eli and Char Nieuwenhuis
OWNERS NIEUWENHUIS BROS DISPOSAL SERVICES
Char and Eli Nieuwenhuis and the entire Nieuwenhuis company have been a big part of Stebnitz Builders and the lives of the three brothers, Dan, Gary and Dave Stebnitz. From high school friendships, to civic volunteering, to Dave helping Eli reach a goal by selling his home to Eli, the close-knit relationship we’ve had between companies has been a long a storied one. Thank you for the kind words, the many years of friendship and your constant and continued company support. You guys are the best!
Tammy Dunn
EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF THE UNITED WAY OF WALWORTH COUNTY
Thank you for the kind words, Tammy. We are proud of our third-generation story involving Stebnitz Builders but also LOVE our “generational story” with the United Way. I know my mom, Barb Stebnitz is extremely proud of the work we’ve continued to do, following in the footsteps her mother (my grandmother), Eleanor Packard, made over 50 years ago! Thanks, Tammy!
Brian and Judy Buzzell
CLIENTS OF STEBNITZ BUILDERS
We caught up with our friends, and past clients, Brian and Judy Buzzell to discuss their experiences working with Stebnitz Builders to completely renovate their Delavan home. While the project may have been several years ago (2008), the memories of a great experience are still fresh in their minds.
Larry Ockelmann
CLIENT AND RETIRED REMODELING CONSULTANT
Larry Ockelmann sent us this message and we couldn’t be happier. Not only were he and his wife, Barbara, clients of Stebnitz Builders, but they are dear friends. Larry also became a Remodeling Consultant with us for several years. He used his experience as a VP with Sears to push me and our team to reach for goals we never thought possible. Thanks for the friendship, your guidance and the kind words, Larry! Can’t imagine where we’d be today without them.
Sara Nichols
EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, OPEN ARMS FREE CLINIC, INC.
Executive Director, Sara Nichols, sent us this nice note of congratulations and to celebrate our 50th Anniversary. Stebnitz Builders has been an avid supporter of Open Arms, providing free medical and dental care to the essential workers and their families in Walworth County. Opened in 2012, OAFC is the first free clinic in Walworth County serving low-income and uninsured people of all ages with primary medical, dental, vision, behavioral health, lab and pharmaceutical assistance.
Chris Egner
OWNER, CHRIS EGNER
Great business relationships are key to not only ensuring our projects are a success from start to finish, but also that our clients have a wonderful experience throughout the process. Chris Egner is one of those partners that allow us to provide both a successful project and a memorable experience. Thanks for the kind words, Chris!
Peggy Helgeson
DISTINCTIVE DESIGNS BY PEGGY
We have a long and great relationship with Peggy, not only as a trusted trade partner and designer with Distinctive Designs by Peggy, but the brothers actually hired Peggy (her first job in the industry) to work with the cabinet/ countertop business they founded – Kustom Kitchen Designs. Peggy found her calling in this industry and studied hard to become a great designer and partner for our clients. Her dedication to creating that relationship with our clients remains strong today. Thanks for the kind words and all you do to help us create raving fans, Peggy!
Randy Schnick
RETIRED, OWNER SCHNICK ELECTRIC
Randy has the distinction of knowing Stebnitz Builders the longest, having started his own business right about the same time as the brothers purchased the company from their father. Randy and Schnick Electric were great partners with us in hundreds (if not thousands) of projects we completed. Thank you for the friendship and the support over those years together, Randy!
Steve Uppling
OWNER, MAD MOSAICS
Thank you for the shout-out, Steve. We truly appreciate the commitment you have to our goal as a company – being the very best listeners and providing unique solutions to wonderful homeowners. The service you provide our clients is crazy-good and the detailing you have for the tile work you perform is amazing. Keep up the great work. We look forward to another four years (and more) of exceptional teamwork and tilework. Thanks for the continued praises you sing for Stebnitz Builders.
Patricia Bladow

Thank you to Patricia Bladow, Executive Officer for the Lakeland Builders Association, for her kind words and reflection on our involvement in the leadership roles with LBA over the last 25 years. The LBA has been not only a great resource for homeowners across the county, but it has helped so many of the colleagues we work alongside in the industry reach greater personal and professional levels. Thanks Pat!

KITCHEN REMODELING & DESIGN
Creating the heart of your home with a disciplined, design-build approach.

Your kitchen is the central fixture of your household—a hub for family communication and a space for entertaining. Whether you require a complete layout redesign to improve workflow or an aesthetic update to modernize your home, our process ensures the result aligns with your lifestyle. We listen to your vision, validate your budget with an “Opinion of Probable Cost,” and deliver exceptional craftsmanship.

Start Your Kitchen Project
A Process-Driven Approach to Your Dream Kitchen
FROM "OPINION OF PROBABLE COST" TO FINAL WALKTHROUGH

A successful kitchen renovation requires more than just skilled carpentry; it requires a detailed roadmap. At Stebnitz Builders, we mitigate the stress of remodeling through our Project Development Agreement (PDA). During this 60-120 day phase, we don’t just sketch ideas; we finalize every detail—from custom cabinetry and quartz countertops to plumbing fixtures and paint colors—before construction ever begins.

This disciplined front-end planning ensures your project stays on budget and on schedule. Once construction starts, your dedicated Production Manager will ensure trade partners are coordinated and your daily life is respected. We replace the anxiety of “budget spiraling” with the confidence of a fixed contract and a clear path forward.

Curious About Remodeling Costs?
PLAN YOUR BUDGET WITH CONFIDENCE

Understanding the investment required for a remodel is the first step toward bringing your vision to life. Download our comprehensive Pricing Guide to see the most current cost ranges for kitchens, bathrooms, additions, and more in Walworth County.

GET THE GUIDE
WHY REMODEL YOUR KITCHEN?
Identifying the goals for your renovation.

Improve Workflow and Layout: Reconfiguring the "work triangle" to make cooking, cleaning, and moving through the kitchen more efficient and less crowded.

Modernize Outdated Aesthetics: Replacing worn cabinets, dark lighting, or old flooring to breathe new life and value into the home.

Expand for Entertaining: Removing walls or adding a central island to create an open-concept space that welcomes family and guests.

Increase Storage Capacity: Incorporating smart storage solutions like pantries, deep drawers, and custom cabinetry to reduce countertop clutter.

Design a tranquil retreat for your daily routine.

Your bathroom is where you start and end every day. It should be a place to prepare for the morning with energy and unwind in the evening with peace. Expand your living space without leaving the home you love.

Beautiful, accessible solutions for your forever home

You love your home, your neighborhood, and your memories. There is no need to leave them behind just because your needs are changing. Stebnitz Builders specializes in “Aging in Place” renovations that blend safety with style. ARCHITECTURAL RESTORATION & PRESERVATION
Honoring the history of your home with master craftsmanship.

Some homes are more than just structures; they are pieces of history. Whether you own a classic Victorian in Lake Geneva or a century-old farmhouse in Walworth County, Stebnitz Builders understands the responsibility of stewardship. We don’t just remodel; we revive. Our team is dedicated to preserving the architectural integrity of your residence, bringing it back to its original glory while ensuring it is built to last for the next generation.

Discuss Your Restoration Project
Respecting the Past, Building for the Future
SEAMLESS INTEGRATION OF PERIOD-CORRECT DETAILS

True restoration requires a delicate balance between modern durability and historical accuracy. It is not about changing the home’s character, but rather uncovering and polishing the details that make it unique. Our design-build process begins with a deep study of your home’s existing architecture—from rooflines and millwork to masonry and siding profiles.

We work to ensure that any updates, whether exterior or interior, feel cohesive with the original structure. Our goal is to maintain the soul of the home. Through our “Project Development” phase, we source materials and craft custom solutions that respect the era of construction, ensuring the finished result looks as if it has always been there, only better.

OUR LATEST PROJECTS
Craftsmanship in Every Detail

Explore a curated collection of our recent transformations across Southeastern Wisconsin. From sweeping lakefront estates to intimate interior resets, our work reflects our dedication to quality and the unique visions of our clients.

Setting the Standard for Lakeside Living

Our portfolio represents over fifty years of architectural excellence throughout Walworth County and the surrounding Southeastern Wisconsin region. While we are widely recognized for our specialized expertise in lake home renovations, our work spans a diverse range of styles—from historic downtown restorations to modern countryside retreats. As you explore our recent projects, you will find everything from whole-home resets and expansive additions to meticulously detailed interior remodels. Explore our project categories below.

QUALITY THAT ENDURES
Our Five-Year Workmanship Promise

While a one-year warranty is the industry standard, we believe our craftsmanship should be held to a higher level of accountability. At Stebnitz Builders, we guarantee our workmanship for five years. This extended commitment is a reflection of our attention to detail and the reason so many clients trust us with their homes time and time again. We don’t just build for today; we build for your future.

Learn About Our Warranty
Every great project starts with a conversation.

Contact our team today to discuss your goals and start the path toward a beautifully reimagined home. We’re here to listen to your ideas and help you discover the full potential of your space.

A local legacy of high-quality renovation

Stebnitz Builders is proud to serve the premier lakefront communities of Walworth County, along with select regions of Rock, Jefferson, and Racine counties. A family-run business since 1972, Stebnitz Builders has completed hundreds of unique remodeling projects earning us the trust and accolades of our clients.
